
## About me
I'm a systems software engineer who's happiest where software meets hardware: from microcontrollers and embedded Linux to backend services and data pipelines. Off the clock, I run a NixOS and Home Assistant homelab I probably over-engineer, mod my Steam Deck more than I play it, build synthwave-flavored VS Code themes, and work on projects with tools and technologies I want to learn.

![GitHub Stats](https://github-stats-xi-six.vercel.app/api/stats?user=sabrsorensen&theme=glass) ![Top Repositories](https://github-stats-xi-six.vercel.app/api/top-repos?user=sabrsorensen&theme=glass)

### I'm a systems software engineer with professional experience in:
* backend APIs, databases, cloud storage providers, and idempotent event processing
* ETL and telemetry ingestion workflows
* embedded systems (AVR, STM32, ESP32, buildroot embedded Linux)
* test & verification

### My hobbyist experience includes projects such as:
* 20+ years of Linux server administration
* Homelab fleet of 8 hosts (9 configurations) managed using a [Dendritic Nix-based framework](https://github.com/sabrsorensen/nix-dendrites): 1 x64 and 2 RPi4 servers, 3 laptops, 1 WSL instance, and 1 dual-booting Steam Deck running both [Jovian NixOS](https://github.com/jovian-experiments/jovian-nixos) and Home Manager on SteamOS
* VS Code/VSCodium themes adding semantically-aware visual effects to the editor workbench: [Synthwave Blues](https://github.com/sabrsorensen/synthwave-blues-vscode-theme), [PartyOwl '84](https://github.com/sabrsorensen/partyowl84-vscode-theme), and [nix-synthwave-vscode](https://github.com/sabrsorensen/nix-synthwave-vscode)
* Embedded Linux OTA proof-of-concept using Hawkbit, swupdate, buildroot, and A/B partitioning
